notes: Shopify store. robots.txt (https://www.butlers.com/robots.txt) checked: only generic bot rules (adsbot-google, Nutch [disallow all], AhrefsBot, AhrefsSiteAudit, MJ12bot, Pinterest, Amazonbot [disallow all]) - no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web/Claude-User/Claude-SearchBot entry, so no policy_opt_out. Accessed via direct HTTP (curl) - full HTTP-tier success, no browser needed. Discovery: fetched /collections.json?limit=250 (173 collections total, page 2 empty confirms complete list - this is the site's full taxonomy) and cross-checked against the rendered main-nav mega menu on the homepage (currently in a Halloween-season configuration as of 2026-09-03 - the 'Trends' dropdown shows Peanuts/Spring Picnic/Brunch & Breakfast/Garden BBQ/Cocktail Party/Bestseller/Ode to Fall/Halloween/Geschenkideen; the Christmas/Advent/Silvester branch is not currently linked in main nav but its collection pages are live, reachable and return HTTP 200, and were verified as real product-listing pages with their own rendered product-count headers, banner images and descriptions - absence from the CURRENT nav rotation is a seasonal-display timing artifact, not evidence the categories don't exist on the site's taxonomy). Qty source: Shopify's own /collections.json 'products_count' field is known-inflated (per project rule) and did not match the rendered count in every case (e.g. 'advent' showed products_count:15 in the API vs the page's own rendered 'X von Y Produkten' status text of 10) - the rendered id="ProductCount" status text on each collection page (format 'N Produkte' or 'X von N Produkten') was used as the authoritative qty in all rows, per the shared core's 'prefer the rendered header' rule. Grouping: /collections/weihnachten ('Weihnachten', H1 'Weihnachten', rendered total 386) is the umbrella Christmas hub whose own total is smaller than the sum of its more specific sibling collections (weihnachtsdeko 279 + weihnachtsgeschenke 150 + weihnachtsgeschirr 40 + weihnachtsglaeser 34 + weihnachtskugeln 4 + weihnachtstafel 176 + weihnachts-tischwaesche 63 + christbaumschmuck 92 + weihnachtsbaeume 1 + tischdeko-weihnachten 98 = 937), indicating it is the deduplicated union/parent of those children (partial overlap) rather than a distinct product set - kept as a grouping row (qty/link null) per the shared overlap rule, consistent with prior Seasonal precedent (see se80.json HSN Home). 'Weihnachtstafel' (Christmas table, 176) and 'Tischdeko Weihnachten' (Christmas table decor, 98) are both live, distinctly named, distinctly counted collections with different titles/descriptions - kept as two separate rows rather than merged, since counts/facets are not identical (Rule 0.6 does not apply). 'Advent' (Adventszeit, general advent-season decor, rendered qty 10) was NOT treated as a parent of Adventskalender/Adventskerzen/Adventskraenze/Adventskalender-Fuellungen (4/16/6/222) because its own total is far smaller than any single one of those, meaning it holds different, smaller content rather than being their union - kept as its own sibling leaf row under Christmas. Excluded as non-seasonal: 'Kraenze' (Wreaths, 'Unsere vielseitigen Kraenze sorgen zu jeder Jahreszeit...' = explicitly described by the site itself as suitable for every season, not seasonally defined - rule 5/6). Excluded as ambiguous style/mood capsule collections, not explicitly holiday-labeled by the site (flagging for manual review rather than silently including or excluding, per the hard rule on loose seasonal-color/style-word categories): 'Noel Grace' (32 products), 'Candy Lane' (27), 'Merry Martini' (25), 'Berry and Green' (36) - all published together 2026-08-25 with null API descriptions and no on-page description text; their names are suggestively Christmas-adjacent (Noel, candy-cane imagery, 'Merry') but the site does not explicitly file them under Weihnachten/Christmas anywhere (they sit in the same 'Trends' nav bucket as unambiguously non-holiday style collections like Cloud Dancer, Glacier Glow, Iconic Seventies, Mountain Lodge, Holy Moly, none of which were included). Excluded as internal marketing/homepage-block collections (handle prefix 'manual_', used to power homepage carousel widgets, not real navigable categories): manual_halloween_highlights1, manual_halloween_highlights2, manual_startseite_xmas, manual_xmas_adventskalender, manual_xmas_adventskalenderfulliungen, manual_xmas_highlights, manual_start_garten, manual_garten_highlights, manual_start_tavira, manual_startseite_neu, manual_startseite_neu-kopie, manual_tischkueche_neu, manual_tischkuche_geschirr_glaser, manual_tischkuche_geschirr_highlights. Excluded as generic marketing/navigation/price-filter pages: neu, sale, aktion-rabattfahige-artikel, bestseller, geschenkideen and its price-tier variants (general gifts, not holiday-specific), geschenke-fur-frauen/geschenke-fur-manner (gender-targeted general gifts, not holiday-specific). Investigated for Easter/Valentine's Day/Mother's Day/Father's Day/Carnival/St. Nicholas/Indian festivals: no matching collection handle exists anywhere in the full 173-collection taxonomy (grep for oster/valentin/mutter/vater/karneval/fasching/nikolaus/diwali/holi/eid returned nothing) - these holidays are genuinely absent from the current live taxonomy, not merely unsearched.
